note: The two sets are nearly identical in content: both capture the two section scales (3/8" = 1'-0"), the finished floor at 2' - 9 1/2" above grade 0' - 0", and the room contents of the centre module and living room section. Both repeat the same errors: the Living Room finished floor is stated as 2' - 3 1/2" although the page (text and image) shows 2' - 9 1/2" in both sections, and both bind 'CENTRE MODULE | location | K' and 'WEST MODULE | location | West' to grid/label markers rather than real locations. Both also duplicate the finished-floor and grade-level elevations and the A1 scale under two names. Differences are cosmetic (A names detail IDs A1/C1 in its scale claims; B adds the 'feet-inches' unit to one finished-floor claim), so neither is meaningfully better.
remarks: Both sets misread the Living Room finished floor as 2' - 3 1/2"; the page shows 2' - 9 1/2" for both the C1 and A1 sections. Both treat grid line K and the 'WEST MODULE' label as locations, and both use the vague entity 'building section' for the bathroom/mechanical-room containment claims. Both also repeat the finished-floor elevation three times and the grade-level elevation twice under slightly different entity names.
